description: This file contains a base test class for prplMesh, which provides common testing methods for handling multi-AP policies, configuration, and STA connection failure simulation within the prplMesh testing framework.

classes.name: CommonFlows
classes.description: A base test class providing common methods for prplMesh testing, such as policy configuration, reporting, and failure simulation.

methods.name: send_and_check_policy_config_metric_reporting(self, controller, agent, include_sta_traffic_stats=True, include_sta_link_metrics=True)
methods.description: Sends a multi-AP policy configuration request with metric reporting policy to a specified agent and verifies acknowledgment.

methods.name: configure_multi_ap_policy_config_with_unsuccessful_association( self, agent, controller, enable: 0x80, max_repeat: 0x0A)
methods.description: Configures multi-AP policy with an unsuccessful association policy on an agent and verifies proper message delivery.

methods.name: fail_sta_connection(self, agent_radio, controller, sta, expect='yes')
methods.description: Simulates multiple failure events for STA association attempts and verifies the proper handling of these failures.

ctags.name: fail_sta_connection
ctags.pattern: /^    def fail_sta_connection(self, agent_radio, controller, sta, expect='yes'):$/
